cards.card_text: It's the Jubilee, when liberty is proclaimed in the land for all its inhabitants, and every time my old junk drawer slid open, all of us in there held our breath hoping for a day like THIS.
cards.verse_text: It shall be your Jubilee, when each of you is to return to his property and to his clan.

cards.card_text: Liberty is proclaimed in the Year of Jubilee.
cards.verse_text: It shall be your Jubilee, when each of you is to return to his property and to his clan.
cards.snippet: It shall be your Jubilee, when each of you is to return to his property and to…

cards.card_text: True or false: In the Jubilee year, God tells Israel not to sow the land or harvest the untended vines.
cards.verse_text: The fiftieth year will be a Jubilee for you; you are not to sow the land or reap its aftergrowth or harvest the untended vines.

cards.card_text: The Jubilee is holy to them.
cards.verse_text: For it is a Jubilee; it shall be holy to you.
cards.snippet: For it is a Jubilee; it shall be holy to you.

cards.card_text: In the Year of Jubilee, each one returns to his own property.
cards.verse_text: In this Year of Jubilee, each of you shall return to his own property.
cards.snippet: In this Year of Jubilee, each of you shall return to his own property.

cards.card_text: Land is priced by the number of harvest years left before the Jubilee.
cards.verse_text: You are to buy from your neighbor according to the number of years since the last Jubilee; he is to sell to you according to the number of harvest years remaining.
cards.snippet: …from your neighbor according to the number of years since the last Jubilee; he is to sell to you according to the number of harvest…

cards.card_text: But village houses and Levite houses go back in the Jubilee, and the Levites' pastureland can't be sold at all.
cards.verse_text: It is not to be released in the Jubilee.
cards.snippet: It is not to be released in the Jubilee.

cards.card_text: True or false: An Israelite who sells himself to a fellow Israelite goes free with his children in the Year of Jubilee.
cards.verse_text: Let him stay with you as a hired worker or temporary resident; he is to work for you until the Year of Jubilee.
cards.snippet: …temporary resident; he is to work for you until the Year of Jubilee.

cards.card_text: He can even buy himself back if he prospers, and the price is figured from the years left until the Jubilee, at a hired hand's daily wages.
cards.verse_text: He and his purchaser will then count the time from the year he sold himself up to the Year of Jubilee.
cards.snippet: …time from the year he sold himself up to the Year of Jubilee.

cards.card_text: If he does it during the Year of Jubilee, that price stands.
cards.verse_text: If he consecrates his field during the Year of Jubilee, the price will stand according to your valuation.
cards.snippet: If he consecrates his field during the Year of Jubilee, the price will stand according to your valuation.

cards.card_text: But say the man consecrates his field after the Jubilee.
cards.verse_text: But if he consecrates his field after the Jubilee, the priest is to calculate the price in proportion to the years left until the next Year of Jubilee, so that your valuation will be reduced.
cards.snippet: But if he consecrates his field after the Jubilee, the priest is to calculate the price in proportion to the years…

cards.card_text: When it's released in the Jubilee, it becomes holy and belongs to the priests.
cards.verse_text: When the field is released in the Jubilee, it will become holy, like a field devoted to the LORD; it becomes the property of the priests.

cards.card_text: The priest figures its value up to the Year of Jubilee, and the man pays it that same day as a sacred offering to the LORD.
cards.verse_text: Now if a man consecrates to the LORD a field he has purchased, which is not a part of his own property, then the priest shall calculate for him the value up to the Year of Jubilee, and the man shall pay the assessed value on that day as a sacred offering to the LORD.

cards.card_text: When the Year of Jubilee comes, where does that field go?
cards.verse_text: In the Year of Jubilee the field shall return to the one from whom it was bought—the original owner of the land.

cards.card_text: Then they bring up the Jubilee, and even then, they say, the land would stay with the tribe the daughters marry into.
cards.verse_text: And when the Jubilee for the Israelites comes, their inheritance will be added to the tribe into which they marry and taken away from the tribe of our fathers.”
